reviews.x: Item arrived as promised and no bottles broken. Most of the polishes take two coats to cover opaquely. A few take three coats to cover. A few of the cream colors are patchy so you need to be careful to apply very thin layers and allow to dry completely. They dry down to a semi matte finish in a few minutes so you’ll need a shiny top coat. The colors are all very pretty and I will use them often. I will update on wear later and maybe give a higher rating.

Terrible nail polish! The consistency is thick and goopy. It does not go on well and it is hard to get a clean finish as the polish is too thick and the brush leaves streaks. I would never buy again, I'm so disappointed. I recommend Zoya, OPI or Essie - it is worth paying more as this is just a waste of money.

reviews.t: Good Quality and Value, any Issues Resolved ASAP
reviews.x: Today I have officially been impressed! SCX, through Brian, has replaced the broken box of nail polish today.  Also, Amazon Representative Meenu promptly responded today as well with a refund.  Both Brian and Meenu have my heart felt thanks for their professionalism in resolving the issue.  Please do not hesitate if contemplating a purchase from SXC Cosmetics and Amazon.  These Companies have just demonstrated superior Customer Service to me.  I will happily reorder with confidence. The polishes

I have natural nails, SHORT, but natural! The reason I bring up natural is because lacquer just doesn't seem to stay on natural nails like they do with acrylics.  These? They DO! Usually polish starts chipping or wearing sometimes as early as the same day I apply! I've tried many, many brands, from a little "cheap" to rather on the expensive side. Nothing worked....until I got these! I would say that maybe by the 5th day, there's a little wear on the ends, but chipping? No. And my hands

reviews.t: Great product.  Great price.  Great seller.
reviews.x: So many beautiful pink colors...so little time...LOL. The only challenge is which one to try next.  Don't know which one I like best!  This polish goes on well, dries fairly fast and no chips after a week.  Very satisfied...no, TOTALLY satisfied with this purchase and this seller.  Packaging and delivery time very impressuve!  Will buy again but will not run out any time soon...LOL.  The price is terrific for the quality of the product you receive.  Love it!

These polishes were priced great and I love the variety of colors! I too used them as party favors for a baby shower. I did have two  polishes come defected though, they looked as if they were used or spilled somehow.

reviews.t: Terrible - Broken Containers and Horrible Smell
reviews.x: Package came and had a smell.  The plastic wrapping seemed a bit off.  When I opened it, I found that at least 3 bottles were broken (and really powerful chemical smell) and contents were spilled all over the box it came in.  Returning and do not recommend - they obviously cannot package appropriately and based on the smell, it does not smell like a quality nail polish.

I was sovplease when I received these to add to my 7yo birthday party favors. I was worried on color would be gold (which it wasn’t) or some of the red/pinks might be too dark for young girls, but they were all perfect! They were packaged in a small thick, divided box and they arrived in perfect condition! I highly recommend!

reviews.t: It was cute but it doesn't stay on your nails ...
reviews.x: It was cute but it doesn't stay on your nails long and has a sticky effect to it once it dries..

reviews.t: Fantastic set for the price, high quality nail polish, some beautiful colors!
reviews.x: This is surprisingly high quality polish for the price. There are some ugly colors in here but some really gorgeous ones as well. I was able to try water marbling with the hot pink and it worked great! It lasts a long time with a few coats as well. I was really surprised by how much I like this set! Great for any pink lover, or for someone looking for a pink they can be happy with.

reviews.t: ... them away for baby shower thank you gifts everyone loved
reviews.x: Gave them away for baby shower thank you gifts everyone loved them

I used these polishes for a manicure jar to be used as a favor for a baby shower. I kept one for myself because I loved the color. I dropped the bottle accidentally on my tile floor. The bottle shattered to pieces. I have never had this happen. All the colors were pretty but the mess I had on the floor was crazy. My warning to all is be very careful especially if you are letting your young daughter use it. I had glass shards and polish all over the floor. What a mess!

Pretty colors. The reason I scored it 3 stars is because when I received the box one bottle had broken inside and leaked on the others. The bottles were stuck to the box because the polish had dried by the time I received it. However I have since changed my rating to a five. The company sent me a whole new box. The colors are beautiful and the nail polish goes on great and stays on.

I purchased this to include in gag gift bags for some very dear friends!!  They LOVED their colors that they were given!! I have to admit that I kept a few because they were so pretty!! I was so thankful that when the package was delivered, that all of the nail polishes hadn't spilled!!  Thank you so much and I will be referring my friends to you as well!!

reviews.t: Buy if you want to get what you didn't think you were getting
reviews.x: Colors in the box aren't like the colors in the description photos, which is one of the teadons i bought this set.  There is no true metalic polish un this set. I get the nail polish is cheap and you have to apply more than one coat (which i guess is what you paid for) but not having the colors in the set comoaired to what your advertising is just wrong.

I was leary when I made this purchase because many reviews talked about how bottles were broken.  I must have been very fortunate as I ordered 2 boxes for a baby shower and absolutely none of them were broken.  When you open the box it smells like nail polish, but isn’t that what was purchased?  Of course!!!  These were a huge hit as party favors.

The polish is lovely. Colors are great and size of bottle equal to OPI. I gave this only four stars because one bottle was broken in shipping and polish went all over other bottles which I have to clean off the other bottles. I feel packing could have been better to prevent this. Otherwise I am happy with product.

pretty colors but don't really like the flat colors .. needs sparkle.  The sparkly ones are nice and good for over top the others.  Update:  I received a replacement set of metallics and I love them to pieces!  Such beautiful colors!  I'm impressed with the quality of service with this company!

I bought these for my daughter’s princess party. All the little girls had the nails painted etc. I paid $14 for 12 so I thought that was a good deal.  My only issue is that the nail polish is a little runny, but what do I expect for the price.  It served it’s purpose.

I really like SXC polish. It lasts a long time. Much longer than ‘China Glaze’ brand I bought At Sally’s Beauty. I also like the variety of colors SXC offers and you can’t beat the price. Super inexpensive for a variety of colors that lasts on your nails. 😃

reviews.t: Great product, but picture don’t match received.
reviews.x: I would’ve given 5 stars but in picture of item bought I was missing the bottom left two colors.  They gave me two others that looked almost identical to others in box.  Very disappointing.  Other than that colors beautiful, quick drying, easy to put on.

Only 9 of the 12 bottles are giftable. A broken/leaking bottle caused the packaging to cement to the bottles. Cardboard stuck to the top. Finally got the culprit bottle out. It’s empty. Have yet to try the polish to see it it’s any good.

These nail polishes are so bright and pretty. I just put one on this morning, so I don't know how well they stay on. I love the selection of colors, they're so bright and pretty. I got the 'pinks'.  Next I think I'll get the 'metallics'.

Used these for a gift at a girls baby shower, and they were a hit! They are actually high quality, opaque, beautiful polishes! The glitter ones are chock full of glitter and there was a good variety of colors as well. Such a good price!

I loved the colors .and they were exactly like the picture . the nail polish was a bargain each one averaged  at just over $1 per 15 ml bottle which is pretty good size ...I ordered one set and liked it so much I ordered another ..

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the beautiful colors and variety in the set, often using it for gifts or party favors.
Several reviewers report broken bottles or leaked polish upon arrival, though some note the issue was resolved quickly by the seller.
Some reviewers find the polish too thick or goopy to apply cleanly, while others say it goes on well and lasts.
A few reviewers note that multiple coats are needed for opaque coverage, and some colors are patchy.
Some reviewers complain that the polish chips or doesn't stay on nails long, while others report no chips after a week.
